name: Use Skill
description: Load a skill body or a support file from its package.

function.name: use_skill
function.description: Load a skill's instructions by id. Long bodies and support files are paginated with offset/limit; optional file loads a package support doc relative to the skill root.

file.description: Optional relative path inside the skill package, e.g. references/structure.md or SKILL.md.

offset.description: Zero-based character offset for the next page (default 0).

limit.description: Maximum body characters per page (default 12000, max 100000).
